module: Facade extension of the "rally loop" mode (chaining service, liaison, special stages). It owns the RallyLoopManager instance (loop/rallyLoopManager) created by setup(missionId, missionDir), relays the game's updates and hooks to it, and publishes the "rallyLoop" UI stream every frame via guihooks.queueStream. Without a manager, it publishes the StandaloneFallbackStream stream (`standaloneUiBridge` mode); getRuntimeMode returns 'rallyLoop', 'standaloneUiBridge' or 'idle'. It also hosts the "Loop Toolbox" debug imgui window.
notes: The UI stream's countdown is hidden (activeState replaced by inactive, countdownData removed) if the `rallyStartCountdownDisplay` setting is not '2d' and the 3D clock is available (or the setting is anything other than '3d').
handleGOTO: the default branch calls rallyLoopManager:startNextMission() even if rallyLoopManager is nil, which causes an error in that case.
For an 'abandon' of a mission in progress (onAnyMissionWillChange with state 'stopped' and abandoned), a DNF attempt is recorded unless the current mission is 'serviceOut'.
Most getters return a neutral value (false, nil, 0) when no manager exists.

setup.desc: Creates the RallyLoopManager for the mission and clears the fallback stream.

unload.desc: Destroys the manager and clears the fallback stream.

isReady.desc: Public API: true if a manager exists.

onUpdate.desc: Extension hook called every frame. Updates the manager and publishes the 'rallyLoop' stream; also handles the Loop Toolbox window.

onGuiUpdate.desc: Hook called on every GUI update; relayed to the manager.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook; only writes a log if debugLogging is active.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Unload hook: publishes a {activeState = inactive} stream and clears the fallback stream.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when the settings change; relayed to the manager (if it handles the hook) and to the fallback stream.

toggleDebug.desc: Shows or hides the Loop Toolbox window.

returns.desc: Toolbox, nil if the window was never opened or is closed.

isLoopToolboxVisible.desc: Indicates whether the Loop Toolbox window is shown.

drawDebug.desc: Delegates the debug drawing to the manager.

onRallyDataUpdated.desc: Hook emitted when the rally data changes; relayed to the manager, otherwise to the fallback stream.

onUIStartButtonClicked.desc: Hook called when the UI start button is clicked; relayed to the manager.

onRecalculatedRoute.desc: Hook called when the route has been recomputed; relayed to the manager.

onCreatedRallyGroundMarkerRoute.desc: Hook called when the ground markers route is created; relayed to the manager.

onRallyVehicleRecovery.desc: Hook called on a vehicle recovery; calls manager:trackRecovery.

onRallyRouteRecoveryComplete.desc: Hook called when the route recovery is finished; relayed to the manager if it handles the hook.

onAnyMissionWillChange.desc: Hook called before any mission state change. Removes the manager's traffic exclusion and records a DNF on abandon (except in serviceOut).

abandoned.desc: true if the mission is abandoned.

setupForNewMission.desc: Prepares the manager for the next mission (manager:setupForNewMission).

setMissionExecutionTransferFlag.desc: Sets the manager's mission execution transfer flag.

getNextMissionId.desc: Id of the loop's next mission.

options.desc: Options passed to the manager (inferred from code).

returns.desc: 'no rally loop manager' without a manager.

addTestPenalty.desc: Records a test penalty in the manager (recordTestPenalty).

amount.desc: Penalty amount (unit inferred from code: time).

returns.desc: Manager result, or false and 'no rally loop manager'.

handleGOTO.desc: Handles a navigation request from the UI: 'restart' restarts the loop, 'abandon' instantly returns to the loop, 'postServiceIn' and any other value start the next mission.

getDrawFlag.desc: Reads a debug drawing flag of the manager.

setDrawFlag.desc: Sets a debug drawing flag of the manager.

getSSRescheduleCount.desc: Number of special stage (SS) reschedules of the manager.
